tweets.text:
President @realDonaldTrump just accepted the 2019 Bipartisan Justice Award for his leadership in the passage of the historic First Step Act!

@the2020club was founded by 20 black Republicans and 20 black Democrats to elevate criminal justice reform above partisan politics. https://t.co/dQtqZSftQO

Last year, President @realDonaldTrump signed the First Step Act into law—the most significant criminal justice reform in many generations.

"We rallied activists and faith leaders and law enforcement and lawmakers alike. We worked across party lines very strongly." https://t.co/PXJlvc3ckM

tweets.text:
Tanesha Bannister received a life sentence for a drug-related offense in 2004.

Her clemency petition was one of 11,000 languishing in the Office of the Pardon Attorney at the end of the Obama Administration.

She was finally freed after President Trump signed the First Step Act. https://t.co/KrzbQ2ZRGe
